title: Person memory item
description: Memory item of the person scope (MemoryItem). The model only proposes an item; the person's own decision through P1 decide with the subject memory_record makes it active, on silence until the card deadline (7 days) the item is discarded (MEM-3). The core computes the space (tenant, person, subject) (MEM-1). The core sets the personal_seen flag (AUD-5). Deletion only by an erasure request (MEM-4, RET-7).

subject.description: The person whose memory this is.

role.description: The role whose tasks read the item.

key.description: Item key: approving a new item with the same key moves the previous one to superseded.

content.description: Text of the item that the model proposed.

personal_seen.description: The personal_seen flag; the model neither sees nor clears it.
